Population.evidence_source: Physical illness that threatened sexual potency in two men seems to have contributed to the suicides. On the eve of a surgery related to a urological illness, one man killed himself. A sibling said, "He told me point blank that he was scared so he didn't go there."

Type.evidence_source: A sibling said, "He told me point blank that he was scared so he didn't go there." A parent of the same deceased person said, My suspicion is based on fear of the surgery and its outcomes. Another sibling corroborated, "Probably he feared if the manhood was not working..." The spouse stated, Based on medical advice, I always insisted on a condom during sex. Some interviewees alluded to the loss of respect due to childlessness as a contributor to one of the suicides; "they [couple] did not have any child. She [widow] did not even respect the man." Another said, One thing was also that he had no child. A friend agreed, He had no child too and he was around 51 years.
